Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that focuses on LULC prediction, but it is conducted at the district level (Prayagraj district, India), not at a national scale. This violates the core inclusion criterion requiring “explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country).” Additionally, while the study implements future LULC projections for 2035 and 2050, it only uses a single modeling scenario (MLP-MC) without ≥2 contrasting future scenarios for quantitative comparison, violating another core inclusion criterion. Although it reports accuracy metrics and produces mapped projections, the regional scale and single-scenario design meet exclusion conditions.)
